source.citation: Davis, J. A., James, R. O., Leckie, J. O. (1978). Surface ionization and complexation at the oxide/water interface: I. Computation of electrical double layer properties in simple electrolytes. Journal of Colloid and Interface Science 63, 480-499.
source.location: Eqs. [24] and [25]; the text on the choice of the capacitances

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), read on the page text
transcription.note: The triple-layer model: protons on the surface plane, the ion pairs of the background electrolyte on a second plane at a distance beta, two constant capacitances in between, psi0 - psi_beta = sigma0/C1 and psi_beta - psi_d = -sigma_d/C2. The paper converts its microfarads per square centimeter here into SI: 140 and 20 uF/cm2 are 1.4 and 0.2 F/m2.

inner_capacitance.description: C1, between the surface plane and the plane of the ion pairs (140 uF/cm2, after Yates et al.).

outer_capacitance.description: C2, between the plane of the ion pairs and the start of the diffuse layer (20 uF/cm2).
